__notes.why-named-workflow: Workflow allow rules only match NAMED workflows (files in .claude/workflows/); scriptPath invocations always prompt. The rule is honored at --settings CLI scope, or project scope once the workspace is trusted.
__notes.validation-warning: An INVALID value anywhere in this file causes Claude Code to silently skip the ENTIRE file in headless mode (hooks and permissions both). Launch interactively once to surface validation errors.
__notes.rename: If you rename the workflow file, change the allow rule to match — a mismatch shows up as a permission prompt that stalls an unattended run.
